verses.1: Mashas Gey Chizion, what are you going to do? You’re about to go up to the roof.
verses.2: The streets of the city of Homyah are filled with joyous people. You have been freed from exile; you are no longer in exile or dead from war.
verses.3: All your officers were captured together. All your treasures were seized and taken away from you. They were all taken from you far away.
verses.4: Therefore, I said, “Stop speaking to me in a harsh manner. Do not provoke me against my people’s daughter.”
verses.5: For it is a day of great turmoil and chaos for the Lord Jehovah’s army, who are stationed on Mount Hizion. They will cry out in pain and despair to the mountain.
verses.6: And they carried Ashpa on a man’s back; along with the walls of the city.
verses.7: And from among your people, those who were chosen, there were many who filled the chariots and horses. And the soldiers rushed into the gate.
verses.8: And he revealed the secrets of Judah. On that day, they were hidden in the house of the forest.
verses.9: And you saw that the gates of the city of David were numerous; they were filled with water from the river.
verses.10: And you counted the houses of Jerusalem. Then the houses were destroyed by the flames of war.
verses.11: And you created them between the fire and the water. But you did not see their creation or their origin from afar.
verses.12: And the Lord God called upon His armies on that day for praise, for worship, and for celebration.
verses.13: And behold, joy and gladness came upon him when he saw his sheep. He ate the meat and drank the wine. But later, he died.
verses.14: And the Lord’s armies were revealed to my ears. If this warning is not fulfilled for you, then say, “Lord, the armies of heaven will be revealed.”
verses.15: So said Adonai, Jehovah’s army: “Go and take this one to the place where he is confined, over the altar.”
verses.16: What are you going there for? And who is waiting for you there? You’ve brought a grave with you to this place. I’ll bury it in the rock, from where he comes.
verses.17: Look, Jehovah is moving you with great force and power. He is carrying you along with him.
verses.18: May you be carried up into a land that is wide enough for your hands to cover it. May death and destruction befall your vehicles. May your house be destroyed.
verses.19: And you will be destroyed from your current state and from your current position.
verses.20: And on that day, I called my servant Eljakim son of Hilkiah.
verses.21: And you shall bless them according to your word. You will strengthen them, and you will give them power over those who oppose them. They will become the rulers of Jerusalem and of the house of Judah.
verses.22: And I gave David a key to the house of David. He could open it, but he couldn’t close it. Nor could he open it again.
verses.23: And he set it in a proper place, so that it would become a sacred altar for his father’s house.
verses.24: And they hung all the decorations from his house on him: the ornaments, the small items from all the storage places, and even all the idols.
verses.25: On that day, the Lord’s army will be destroyed. The tower will collapse in a certain place, and it will fall down. The one who was on top of it will also be destroyed. For the Lord has spoken.
